title: Viva Engage: collapse and resize the left navigation, and favourite and reorder more communities
summary: The briefing accurately reports the user-initiated navigation controls and the revised rollout window, while preserving the disagreement between Microsoft's three favourites limits. The updated setup requirements still support its licensing wording; all five Learn pages flagged as unavailable were readable in this check.
